description: What the main window is allowed to do everywhere. App commands are plain #[tauri::command]s and need no extra permission; plugins (opener, updater) are only used from Rust, so the page gets none of their permissions. allow-destroy ends the app after the 'connections are still open' question on Windows and Linux. The title bar's controls are in desktop.json, the macOS menu bar in macos.json; anything beyond that has to be added deliberately.
